local-llama31-8b.note: Primary local reviewer. Meta family, different from the Qwen target. ~4.9 GB, fits an 8 GB GPU.

local-gemma3-4b.note: Second local reviewer. Google family. Use after the primary reviewer; comfortably smaller than a 12B model on an 8 GB laptop.

runpod-gemma3-12b.note: RunPod Gemma 3 12B reviewer served by Ollama.

local-qwen3-coder-30b.note: Same family as the target model. Use only as a third opinion, never as a sole reviewer; report the shared-family caveat.

vllm-llama31-8b.note: First rented-GPU reviewer. Run the Hugging Face checkpoint with vLLM; use this before paying for a 70B reviewer.

vllm-gemma3-12b.note: Primary rented-GPU reviewer. Google Gemma 3 12B Instruct, served locally by vLLM in BF16 on a 48 GB GPU.

vllm-llama33-70b.note: Open-weights second reviewer served by vLLM on a rented GPU. Use bf16 on multiple 80 GB GPUs or an explicitly pinned quantized checkpoint on one large GPU.
